name: dsh-ceo-webhook
description: DSH Plugin (NOT part of AICompany core). HTTP webhook channel that turns an incoming POST into a real, tool-capable DSH agent and streams its result back. Lets a local orchestrator (AICompany) drive a CEO agent that can read files and execute tools — reusing the same agents/agentPresets services the Feishu (dsh-lark-channel) plugin uses.
